questions.question: What method is commonly used to calculate the charge-to-mass ratio from experimental data?

answers.a: Direct measurement of charge and mass
answers.b: Using the radius of curvature of an electron beam in a magnetic field
answers.c: Measuring the current in the circuit
answers.d: Observing the color of emitted light

questions.question: In the experiment to determine the charge to mass ratio, how does increasing the magnetic field strength affect the deflection of the electron beam?

answers.c: Has no effect on the beam

questions.question: Why is it important to have a vacuum inside the cathode-ray tube during the charge to mass experiment?

answers.a: To prevent electron collisions with air molecules
answers.b: To increase the weight of the electrons
answers.d: To improve the electron color visibility

questions.question: What is the significance of the charge-to-mass ratio experiment conducted by J.J. Thomson?

answers.a: It proved the existence of protons
answers.b: It measured the speed of light
answers.c: It was the first step in identifying the electron as a subatomic particle
